title: Restore the IRS Forms assisted setup registration removed by the CLEAN25 sweep
summary: The IRS Forms setup wizard registration that was accidentally removed during a code cleanup sweep has been restored, allowing US users to access the 1099 setup guide from the Assisted Setup list again.
key_points: Re-registered the IRS Forms wizard page in the Assisted Setup list via codeunit 10030 with an unconditional subscriber
Automatically marks the setup as complete for companies that have already configured 1099 reporting periods
Includes permission guards to prevent page failures for users without access to the IRS Reporting Period table
Added comprehensive test coverage with four test cases validating registration, completion logic, and UI behavior
